_comment: Golden evaluation set for RAG pipeline. Each entry has: id, query, expected_facts (claims the answer MUST contain), expected_chunks (text substrings that should appear in accepted_chunks), category, difficulty. expected_chunk_ids are doc_id:chunk_index pairs — leave empty to rely on text-substring matching only.

cases.query: What BLEU score did the Transformer achieve on the WMT 2014 English-to-German translation task?
expected_facts: The Transformer (big) achieved 28.4 BLEU on WMT 2014 English-to-German
This improved over existing best results including ensembles by over 2 BLEU

cases.query: How many attention heads does the Transformer base model use?
expected_facts: The Transformer base model uses 8 parallel attention heads
